name: Brazil Nut Keratin Hair Mask 500ml | Nourishing, Strengthening & Smoothing Hair Treatment
description:
Brazil Nut Keratin Hair Mask is an intensive hair treatment designed to restore softness, shine, and strength to dry, frizzy, and damaged hair. Infused with keratin, argan oil, natural plant essences, and moisture-locking minerals, it nourishes strands, strengthens hair from root to tip, and promotes a healthy scalp. Its anti-frizz formula smooths hair, leaving it manageable, silky, and visibly healthier. Suitable for all hair types.
Key Features
 Strengthens and nourishes dry, damaged, and frizzy hair
 Infused with keratin, argan oil, and natural plant essences
 Boosts shine, softness, and overall hair health
 Seals moisture and protects against frizz and humidity
 Restores thickness and nourishes split ends
 Suitable for all hair types, especially dry and damaged hair
How to Use
 After shampooing, gently remove excess water from hair
 Apply generously to damp hair, focusing on mid-lengths and ends
 Massage into scalp and hair with fingertips or a wide-tooth comb
 Leave on 10–20 minutes, then rinse thoroughly
 For best results, wrap hair in a warm towel or steam for 20 minutes before rinsing
Material
Keratin, argan oil, brazil nut extract, natural plant essences, moisture-locking minerals
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 500ml Brazil Nut Keratin Hair Mask
